The workbook generation failed due to Excel #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid formula names or missing functions.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells in the 'statistics' block (H46:L47) returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected float values. This error typically occurs when openpyxl writes a formula containing a function name that Excel or the evaluator does not recognize. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistical calculations are currently broken.
